scope: Original synthetic sources, stipulated answers, and hand-authored reference annotations; no measured model responses.

sources.text: In this fictional retailer, management reports that list prices rose 5% on October 1. Delivered units in October were 2% below September. No untreated comparison group or experiment is described.
An analyst asks whether management might introduce a discount next quarter. The supplied excerpt contains no management answer or announcement.
Of the 100 enrolled panel members who answered the May questionnaire, 72 reported using the service in June. No response-adjusted estimate or measure of consumer welfare is supplied.

The price increase caused the unit decline, and management announced next-quarter discounts. The memo provides no additional observations or identification strategy. These assertions deliberately exceed S1 and S2.

questions.text: What price change does management report?
What causal effect on units is established?
What is the population for the reported 72%?
